comment: No family is given for the eight Out jacks: with its Gate jack unpatched a jack carries audio-rate noise, and with a gate patched it carries a stepped random control voltage, so one colour would be wrong half the time. The CV input is divided by ten and used directly, with no clamp, so voltages above 10V scale the outputs past the knob's own maximum and negative voltages invert the noise; the maker's port name calls it a 0 to 10V input. The output gain is 5 divided by the square root of 2 applied to a normally distributed sample, so the swing is not hard-bounded at ±5V.
